## Installation

The SDK is distributed from GitHub release tags (it is built on install via the `prepare` script).

```bash
npm install github:Statflo/statflo-typescript-sdk#V4.1.214 --save
```

or add it to your `package.json`:

```json
"dependencies": {
  "@statflo/statflo-typescript-sdk": "github:Statflo/statflo-typescript-sdk#V4.1.214"
}
```

## Getting Started

Please follow the [installation](#installation) instruction and execute the following TypeScript code:

```ts
import { Configuration, CampaignApi } from '@statflo/statflo-typescript-sdk';
import type { CampaignPaginationResponse } from '@statflo/statflo-typescript-sdk';

async function campaignExample() {
  const config = new Configuration({
    basePath: process.env.STATFLO_HOST,
    accessToken: process.env.STATFLO_ACCESS_TOKEN,
  });

  const campaignApi = new CampaignApi(config);

  const response: CampaignPaginationResponse = await campaignApi.campaignSearch({
    filter: {},
    query: '',
    page: 1,
    perPage: 10,
    sort: '',
  });
  for (const campaign of response.items ?? []) {
    console.log(campaign);
  }
}

campaignExample().catch(console.error);
```
